HOLD: concrete misattribution, plus a missing named person. p089's other-person-fact reads 'Falsely claimed descent from Duke Zheng's campaign lineage and survival by entering the palace women's quarters', from 「悟素與師道妻魏亂，妄言鄭公征之裔，不死，沒入掖廷」. 鄭公征 is Wei Zheng (魏徵, Duke of Zheng, with 征 written for 徵), not a 'campaign lineage'. The sentence's subject is 悟: Liu Wu, her long-time lover (亂), falsely declared her Wei Zheng's descendant, so she escaped execution and was confiscated into the palace women's quarters. The named historical person Wei Zheng (鄭公征) at s0129 has no person or mention record in the chapter. The candidate header per_9QZ19946VPM63SX53YH7 (魏/Wei Zheng) is visible but was not reviewed as an identity. Lady Wei's own attribution as Shidao's wife (s0129 妻魏) is supported. Proposed correction: rewrite the fact (Liu Wu's false declaration; Lady Wei spared and confiscated into the palace), add a retrospective Wei Zheng (鄭公征) person and mention record, fix the paired Liu Wu relationship, and repair s0129 in both English fields (supplemental omission artifact).
